title: TRVM-HOLDOUT-OBSERVATION-v1
description: The neutral document an implementation emits after applying a holdout recipe. PROCEDURAL, not normative: it is the boundary between an implementation and a scorer that loads no protocol code. See HOLDOUT-OBSERVATION-v1.md. Frozen BEFORE the challenge set is revealed, so that the shape of a Go observation is not chosen in the light of the challenges it will answer.

implementation.description: Free-form label naming the producer, e.g. javascript, go. Not interpreted.

spec_release_id.description: The release this run was written against. Two observation documents are comparable only when these agree.

observations.description: One entry per challenge, keyed by challenge id.

observation.description: Every member is OPTIONAL. A member the recipe did not produce is ABSENT — never null, never a zero value. 'the checker returned nothing' and 'the checker was not asked' are different observations and a predicate can tell them apart.

refusal_set.description: SORTED and DISTINCT, so that byte equality is set equality. [] means a verification refused nothing; ABSENT means no verification happened.

outcome.description: The observable resolution outcome of TRVM-PROOF-WIRE-v1 section 3.3 — the outcome, not the internal stage at which a strict parser noticed (section 3.6).

fixture_root.description: REQUIRED. The content address the adapter actually resolved to obtain the fixture. The scorer independently requires this to equal the challenge's declared fixture.root: an adapter that fetched by the convenience label and checked the root afterwards is indistinguishable from one that fetched by the root, unless it has to report what it fetched.

plane.description: Nodes of the frozen public DAG, plus 'leaf' for a leaf fixture.

structure.description: Reported VERBATIM as the artifact carries it. An implementation does not recompute, round, reorder or omit members here: the point of the plane is whether two implementations derived the same structural facts.
